verdict.rationale: Sentry docs confirm a Dashboards product for cross-project error/performance overviews, and pricing tiers reference '10 custom dashboards,' showing dashboards are a real, gated feature. However, no evidence describes rich visualization type options, template variables, or explicit dashboard-sharing mechanics as called for in the story. Missing for 10: documentation of visualization widget types, template variable support, and shareable-link/permission features for dashboards.
